Title: 1. Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
description: A farmboy joins forces with various allies to save their galaxy from the evil Empire's planet-destroying battle station, while also rescuing the princess leading the rebellion against them.

Title: 2. Close Encounters of the Third Kind
description: An Indiana electric lineman finds his quiet and ordinary daily life turned upside down after a close encounter with a UFO, spurring him to an obsessed cross-country quest for answers as a momentous event approaches.

Title: 3. Smokey and the Bandit
description: The Bandit is hired on to run a tractor-trailer full of beer over state lines, in hot pursuit by a pesky sheriff.

Title: 4. Saturday Night Fever
description: Anxious about his future after high school, a 19-year-old Italian-American from Brooklyn tries to escape the harsh reality of his bleak family life by dominating the dance floor at the local disco.

Title: 5. The Rescuers
description: Two mice of the Rescue Aid Society search for a little girl kidnapped by unscrupulous treasure hunters.

Title: 6. A Bridge Too Far
description: Operation Market Garden, September 1944: The Allies attempt to capture several strategically important bridges in the Netherlands in the hope of breaking the German lines.

Title: 7. The Deep
description: In Bermuda, two amateur treasure-hunting divers have a run-in with local criminals when they inadvertently discover the secret cargo of a World War II shipwreck.

Title: 8. The Spy Who Loved Me
description: James Bond investigates the hijacking of British and Russian submarines carrying nuclear warheads, with the help of a K.G.B. agent whose lover he killed.

Title: 9. Oh, God!
description: When God appears to an assistant grocery manager as a good-natured old man, the Almighty selects him as His messenger to the modern world.

Title: 10. Pete's Dragon
description: An orphaned boy and his magical dragon come to the New England town of Passamaquoddy with his abusive adoptive parents in pursuit.

Title: 11. Annie Hall
description: Alvy Singer, a divorced Jewish comedian, reflects on his relationship with ex-lover Annie Hall, an aspiring nightclub singer, which ended abruptly just like his previous marriages.

Title: 12. Semi-Tough
description: A three-way friendship between two free-spirited professional football players and the owner's daughter becomes compromised when two of them become romantically involved.

Title: 13. Heroes
description: A Vietnam veteran suffering from post traumatic stress disorder breaks out of a VA hospital and goes on a road trip with a sympathetic traveler to start a worm farm in California with his fellow veterans.

Title: 14. High Anxiety
description: A psychiatrist with intense acrophobia (fear of heights) goes to work for a mental institution run by doctors who appear to be crazier than their patients, and have secrets that they are willing to commit murder to keep.

Title: 15. Exorcist II: The Heretic
description: A teenage girl once possessed by a demon finds that it still lurks within her. Meanwhile, a priest investigates the death of the girl's exorcist.

Title: 16. Herbie Goes to Monte Carlo
description: Herbie, the Volkswagen Beetle with a mind of its own, is racing in the Monte Carlo Rally. Unbeknownst to Herbie's driver, thieves have hidden a stolen diamond in Herbie's gas tank, and are now trying to get it back.

Title: 17. Slap Shot
description: A failing ice hockey team finds success with outrageously violent hockey goonery.

Title: 18. The Gauntlet
description: A hard but mediocre cop is assigned to escort a prostitute into custody from Las Vegas to Phoenix, so that she can testify in a mob trial. But a lot of people are literally betting that they won't make it into town alive.

Title: 19. The Turning Point
description: When her daughter joins a ballet company, a former dancer is forced to confront her long-ago decision to give up the stage to have a family.

Title: 20. The Other Side of Midnight
description: A Greek tycoon's mistress tries to track down and find her ex-World War II lover.

Title: 21. Looking for Mr. Goodbar
description: Dedicated schoolteacher Theresa Dunn spends her nights cruising bars, looking for males with whom she can engage in progressively dangerous extreme sexual encounters.

Title: 22. Julia
description: At the behest of an old and dear friend, playwright Lillian Hellman undertakes a dangerous mission to smuggle funds into Nazi Germany.

Title: 23. The Bad News Bears in Breaking Training
description: A troubled, rebellious teen drives his rambunctious baseball team out to Houston where they play an exhibition game and the boy meets his estranged father, and hires him as the teams coach.

Title: 24. For the Love of Benji
description: Benji sniffs out a bogus CIA agent in Athens, Greece.

Title: 25. New York, New York
description: An egotistical saxophonist and a young lounge singer meet on VJ Day and embark upon a strained and rocky romance, even as their careers begin a long, uphill climb.

Title: 26. Black Sunday
description: When a Black September terrorist group begins a plot to carry out a massive terrorist attack in the United States, an Israeli commando works with the FBI to identify the target and conspirators, and prevent the plan from succeeding.

Title: 27. Orca
description: A fisherman and his crew are targeted by a killer whale seeking vengeance for the death of its mate.

Title: 28. Bobby Deerfield
description: Bobby Deerfield, a Formula 1 driver, quits racing after his teammate dies in a crash. He meets Lillian at a medical facility, falls for her, and their relationship takes an unexpected turn when he learns why she's there.

Title: 29. Islands in the Stream
description: An isolated sculptor is visited by his three sons just before the start of WWII.

Title: 30. Race for Your Life, Charlie Brown
description: Welcome to Camp Remote. where Charlie Brown, Lucy, Linus, Snoopy and the rest of the gang are in for the ultimate summer camp experience.

Title: 31. March or Die
description: During the 1920s, French Foreign Legion Major William Foster's (Gene Hackman's) unit is protecting an archaeological dig, but the discovery of an Arab sacred burial site prompts the angry Arab tribes to attack Foster's small garrison.

Title: 32. Joseph Andrews
description: Lady Booby alias "Belle" (Ann-Margret), the lively wife of the fat landed squire Sir Thomas Booby (Peter Bull), has a lusty eye on the attractive, intelligent villager Joseph Andrews (Peter Firth), a Latin pupil and protégé of Parson Adams (Sir Michael Hordern), and makes him their footman. Joseph's heart belongs to a country girl, foundling Fanny Goodwill (Natalie Ogle), but his masters take him on a fashionable trip to Bath, where the spoiled society comes mainly to see and be seen, yet Sir Thomas really seeks relief for his sick foot, but drowns in the famous Roman baths. When the all but grieving lady finds Joseph's Christian virtue and true love resist her lusting passes just as well as the many ladies who fancy her footman, she fires the boy. On his way back on foot, he falls prey to highwaymen who rob him of everything, even the clothes on his back. He's found and nursed by an innkeeper's maid, which stirs lusts there, again besides his honorable conduct, but is found by the good Parson. Meanwhile, the lady consents to her cousin marrying below his station when learning the fiancée is Joseph's sister, Pamela (Karen Dotrice). The Parson barely escapes a wicked gentleman's totally unjust, all but gentle justice after being accused of the attempted rape committed by a squire he actually prevented, and comes to learn ever more about a relevant child-theft by Gypsies, but meanwhile, he, Joseph, and Fanny, fall prey again to the rapist's utter debauchery.

Title: 33. Citizens Band
description: The interlaced stories of several characters in a small town united by their use of CB (citizen's band) radio.

Title: 34. Fraternity Row
description: Story of an upper class college in the early '50s and how a "harmless" hazing resulted in a student's death.

Title: 35. House
description: A schoolgirl and six of her classmates travel to her aunt's country home, which turns out to be haunted.

Title: 36. A Grin Without A Cat
description: French essay film focusing on global political turmoil in the 1960s and '70s, particularly the rise of the New Left in France and the development of socialist movements in Latin America.

Title: 37. The Devil, Probably
description: Charles drifts through politics, religion and psychoanalysis, rejecting them all. Once he realises the depth of his disgust with the moral and physical decline of the society he lives in, he decides that suicide is the only option...

Title: 38. Opening Night
description: A renowned actress teeters on the edge of a breakdown as she counts down the days toward a big Broadway opening.

Title: 39. One Sings, the Other Doesn't
description: The lives of Pomme, an aspiring singer, and Suzanne, a struggling mother, as they search for their own identity in 1970s France.

Title: 40. Goliathon
description: A greedy Hong Kong businessman hires a young hunter to capture a giant gorilla said to live deep in the Indian jungle. The hunter finds the ape, and living with it he finds a feral human female who has befriended the creature.

Title: 41. Between the Lines
description: The lives and tribulations of staff of an independent newspaper in Boston who're struggling financially. Unbeknownst to them, they are about to be taken over by a big publisher; an idea they despise.

Title: 42. Short Eyes
description: A child molester sent to prison finds that criminals exact harsher justice than society.

Title: 43. The Last Wave
description: A Sydney lawyer defends five Aboriginal Persons in a ritualized taboo murder and in the process learns disturbing things about himself and premonitions.

Title: 44. The Late Show
description: A private investigator comes out of retirement when a former partner shows up at his door with a bullet in his gut. At the funeral, an acquaintance brings him a client looking for her stolen cat, which is connected to his partner's murder.

Title: 45. Sorcerer
description: Four unfortunate men from different parts of the globe agree to risk their lives transporting gallons of nitroglycerin across dangerous Latin American jungle.

Title: 46. Eraserhead
description: Henry Spencer tries to survive his industrial environment, his angry girlfriend, and the unbearable screams of his newborn mutant child.

Title: 47. Suspiria
description: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.

Title: 48. Rolling Thunder
description: A recently-returned Vietnam POW loses his family and his right hand during a violent home invasion, and seeks retribution against those responsible.

Title: 49. The Duellists
description: France, 1801. Due to a minor perceived slight, mild-mannered Lieutenant d'Hubert is forced into a duel with the hot-headed and irrational, Lieutenant Feraud; their disagreement ultimately resulting in scores of duels spanning several years.

Title: 50. The Hills Have Eyes
description: On the way to California, a family has the misfortune to have their car break down in an area closed to the public, and inhabited by violent savages ready to attack.

Title: 51. 3 Women
description: Two roommates/physical therapists, one a vain woman and the other an awkward teenager, share an increasingly bizarre relationship.

Title: 52. Playing with Love
description: A teen boy grows from playing and fighting with his German-shepherd dog to playing kid--then adult--games with two equally young girls in a dream-like forest which eventually turns eerie and somber.

Title: 53. Wizards
description: On a post-apocalyptic Earth, a wizard and his faire folk comrades fight an evil wizard who's using technology in his bid for conquest.

Title: 54. The Sentinel
description: A New York fashion model's old brownstone houses a sinister evil.

Title: 55. The American Friend
description: Tom Ripley, who deals in forged art, suggests a picture framer he knows would make a good hit man.

Title: 56. The Island of Dr. Moreau
description: A shipwrecked survivor discovers a remote island owned by a crazed scientist who is carrying out sinister experiments on the island's inhabitants.

Title: 57. Demon Seed
description: A terrified child psychologist must survive her own automated house when her husband's rogue AI takes her hostage to force a pregnancy, but the machine's chilling logic threatens her sanity, all while the domestic space becomes a trap.

Title: 58. Rabid
description: A young woman develops a taste for human blood after experimental plastic surgery, and her victims turn into blood-thirsty zombies, leading into a city-wide epidemic.

Title: 59. Cross of Iron
description: German commander Hauptmann Stransky places a squad in extreme danger after Sergeant Rolf Steiner refuses to lie for him.

Title: 60. Sexy Sisters
description: Edna confines Millie, her younger sister, to her bed while she is sedated. If Edna can show Millie is insane, she will be able to claim a estate for herself. However, Millie learns Edna's malicious schemes.

Title: 61. Bilitis
description: A coming of age story centering on the exploits of a young girl during summer vacation.

Title: 62. The Ascent
description: Two Soviet partisans on a mission to gather food contend with the winter cold, the occupying Germans, and their own psyches.

Title: 63. The Psychic
description: A clairvoyant woman discovers a skeleton in a wall in her husband's house, and seeks to find the truth about what happened to the victim.

Title: 64. A Special Day
description: Two neighbors, a persecuted journalist and a resigned housewife, meet during Hitler's visit to Italy in May 1938.

Title: 66. That Obscure Object of Desire
description: Recounted in flashback are the romantic perils of Mathieu, a middle-aged French sophisticate as he falls for his nineteen-year-old former chambermaid Conchita.

Title: 67. Martin
description: A young man, who believes himself to be a vampire, goes to live with his elderly and hostile cousin in a small Pennsylvanian town, where he tries to suppress his blood-lust.

Title: 68. Stroszek
description: In Berlin, an alcoholic man, recently released from prison, joins his elderly friend and a prostitute in a determined dream to leave Germany and seek a better life in Wisconsin.

Title: 69. Nuns That Bite

Title: 70. The Haunting of Julia
description: After her daughter's death, wealthy American homemaker Julia Lofting moves to London to restart her life. All seems well until she is haunted by the ghosts of other children while mourning for her own.

Title: 71. Grand Theft Auto
description: A rich girl steals her dad's Rolls Royce and heads off to Las Vegas to get married, but her angry parents, a jealous suitor, and a bunch of reward-seekers are determined to stop her.

Title: 72. Iphigenia
description: To appease offended gods before going to war, a commander must sacrifice his favorite daughter to them but does so under the pretext of marrying her off.

Title: 73. Death Game
description: An affluent businessman allows two sexy women to take shelter in his home during a storm, where they proceed to seduce and then torment him.

Title: 74. Emanuelle Around the World
description: Photojournalist Emanuelle encounters a guru who claims to be capable of the ultimate orgasm, and later helps a fellow reporter pursue a global woman-trafficking ring.

Title: 75. The Goodbye Girl
description: After being dumped by her live-in boyfriend, unemployed dancer Paula McFadden and her ten-year-old daughter Lucy are forced to live with struggling off-Broadway actor Elliot Garfield, who is subletting their apartment.

Title: 76. Rollercoaster

Title: 77. Telefon
description: A Russian officer is sent to the U.S. to try and stop sleeper agents who will mindlessly attack government entities when they hear certain coded words.

Title: 78. Jabberwocky
description: A young peasant with no interest in adventure or fortune is mistaken for the kingdom's only hope when a horrible monster threatens the countryside.

Title: 79. The Man Who Loved Women
description: Bertrand Morane, a 40-year-old engineer, dies. At his funeral, his past lovers gather, revealing his life and affairs as he narrates while writing his autobiography.

Title: 80. Airport '77
description: Art thieves hijack a 747, hit fog and crash into the ocean, trapping them and the passengers under one hundred feet of water.

Title: 81. Ilsa, the Wicked Warden
description: A woman enters a brutal psychiatric institution under a false identity to find her missing sister, only to discover a system built on exploitation, secrecy, and absolute control.

Title: 88. Empire of the Ants
description: Con artist Marilyn Fryser tries to sell phony real estate deals in an area that is overrun by giant ants.

description: A year in the life of two adolescent sisters at an all-girls school in France as they experience a rapid-fire onslaught of 'firsts' during a time of political protest and social change.

Title: 90. Shock Waves
description: Visitors to a remote island discover that a reclusive Nazi commandant has been breeding a group of Zombie soldiers.

Title: 91. Damnation Alley
description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a group of survivors travel and find other settlements in huge custom designed all terrain vehicles.

Title: 92. Man of Marble
description: A young Polish filmmaker sets out to find out what happened to Mateusz Birkut, a bricklayer who became a propaganda hero in the 1950s but later fell out of favor and disappeared.

description: Husamettin the commander in the army is constantly bothered by the stupidity of one of his soldiers Saban. After discharge from the army, Saban and his friend Ramazan work in a night club as member of the band. They ran again into Husamettin and his in laws, but things gets complicated when the diamond of the family is been stolen.

Title: 94. The King of the Street Cleaners
description: Going through his daily routine in a stereotypical neighborhood, a street cleaner falls in love with a charwoman. Unfortunately for him, so does his boss.

Title: 95. The Chaos Class Is on Vacation
description: Hababam Sinifi (The Chaos Class) continue to their adventures. Now first female students of the school history joins to the class and all Hababam Sinifi fight each other for them at first but later they understand that female students are trouble as much as Hababam Sinifi and played with them so they decide to fight against that girls.

description: A serial rapist transfers to a new high school, and starts sexually assaulting a group of female students, including the school's top athlete and its most influential student, a track and field star.

Title: 97. Last Cannibal World
description: In the rainforests of the Philippines, an oil prospector escapes the clutches of a violent cannibal tribe with a female hostage, then searches for his missing companion and their plane.

Title: 98. Emanuelle and the Last Cannibals
description: Photojournalist Emanuelle is joined by an anthropologist, two female missionary workers and a treacherous hunter's party in a search for an Amazon cannibal tribe long thought extinct.

Title: 99. The Bishop's Bedroom
description: Mario, a rich and eccentric war hero befriends Marco, a loner with a sailboat and takes him home to meet his estranged wife Cleofe and sexually repressed sister in law Matilde.

Title: 100. Sinbad and the Eye of the Tiger
description: Sinbad the Sailor sails to deliver a cursed prince to a dangerous island in the face of deadly opposition from the powerful witch Zenobia, her son and their several monsters.

Title: 101. Voodoo Passion
description: Susan comes to Haiti to be with her husband. His naked sister asks her, if she's ever made love to a woman. Susan dreams vividly of nudity, Voodoo rituals and killing.

Title: 102. Valentino
description: In 1926 the tragic and untimely death of a silent screen actor caused female moviegoers to riot in the streets and in some cases to commit suicide.

Title: 103. Audrey Rose
description: A stranger attempts to convince a happily married couple that their daughter is actually his daughter reincarnated.

Title: 104. Confessions from a Holiday Camp
description: Timothy Lea finds work in a holiday camp, and is soon up to his usual sexy shenanigans when he organizes a beauty pageant.

Title: 105. Ilsa the Tigress of Siberia
description: Ilsa runs a Gulag with the intention of breaking anti-Communist prisoners, but flees to Canada after Stalin's death to run a brothel, where the sole survivor of her tyranny seeks revenge.

Title: 106. The White Buffalo
description: At the closing of 1874 a haunted, dying Wild Bill Hickok teams up with a grieving Crazy Horse to hunt a murderous albino buffalo.

Title: 107. Cheering Section
description: A high school football star tries to romance the new girl at the school who happens to be his coach's daughter.

Title: 108. Shock
description: A woman returns to the home where her first husband died, only to find her young son acting stranger each day. Something in that house wants her back, and it is using the boy to make sure she never leaves.

Title: 109. I Never Promised You a Rose Garden
description: A disturbed, institutionalized 16-year-old girl struggles between fantasy and reality.

Title: 110. Satan's Cheerleaders
description: The cheer-leading squad gets kidnapped by a janitor working for Satanists needing a virgin sacrifice, but one of the cheerleaders is a witch.

Title: 111. Sleeping Dogs
description: A New Zealand man recently estranged from his family gets unwittingly caught up in a revolution.

Title: 112. Marquis de Sade's Justine
description: Justine, a naive virgin orphan, is thrown into a world of prostitution, encounters twisted individuals like lesbians, a fugitive killer, is subjected to bondage, branding, and torture by a sadistic monk.

Title: 113. Sextette
description: On the day of her wedding to her sixth husband, a glamorous silver screen sex symbol is asked to intervene in a political dispute between nations, which leads to chaos.

Title: 114. The Incredible Melting Man
description: An astronaut is transformed into a murderous gelatinous mass after returning from an ill-fated space voyage.

Title: 115. The Serpent's Egg
description: Berlin, 1923. Following the suicide of his brother, American circus acrobat Abel Rosenberg attempts to survive while facing unemployment, depression, alcoholism and the social decay of Germany during the Weimar Republic.

Title: 116. Erotiki teleti
description: A wealthy seductress enlists the help of two friends in a simple job that will set them all up for life. But everyone knows there's no such thing as a foolproof plan.

Title: 117. Death of a Corrupt Man
description: Deputy Dubaye kills racketeer Serrano, revealing corrupt dealings. Xavier covers up, but faces difficulties as influential personalities seek documents to blackmail Dubaye.

Title: 118. Padre Padrone
description: The son of a shepherd embarks in the quest of emancipating himself from a tough lifestyle that his condition and his father force on him.

Title: 119. The Forbidden Room
description: Bizarre events keep occurring in an old mansion in Venezia, and it's soon obvious that something mysterious is up in the attic.

Title: 120. Godzilla
description: An American reporter uncovers Godzilla, a nuclear-awakened monster devastating Tokyo; weapons fail as a scientist's deadly cure could wipe out all life in the bay, forcing a dire choice.

Title: 121. An Average Little Man
description: A meek middle-aged man finally takes justice into his own hands.

Title: 122. Mimino
description: Local Georgian pilot Mimino dreams of flying airplanes for major international airlines. To realize his aspirations, he goes to Moscow where he encounters a fellow comrade from the Caucasus, the Armenian Rubik. Many misadventures ensue.

Title: 123. The Girl with the Red Scarf
description: Story of a dilemma between a woman's love and her logic. Asya, a young girl with a strict mother, meets Ilyas, who is a womanizer city man, and they quickly fall in love. They get over the hardships and have a happy marriage. However, after he helps a man one night, Ilyas' life changes forever and he leaves Asya and their son for another woman and doesn't come back.

Title: 124. Providence
description: A dying writer bases his last book on his own perception of his family.

Title: 125. Hitler: A Career
description: This meticulously assembled film dissects the Third Reich with an analytical blade, charting Hitler's improbable rise, his mastery of crowd psychology and his consummate skill in exploiting others' weaknesses.

Title: 126. Space Battleship Yamato
description: Gamilons are a race of evil aliens that are trying to destroy the planet Earth. However, a group of civilians look to the battleship Yamato for its space travel and go on a mission to bring back a neutralizer that will get rid of the radiation from the Earth.

Title: 127. Starship Invasions
description: An advance team from a dying, far-off civilization seeks a new world to conquer and inhabit - Earth.

Title: 128. Taxi Girl
description: Marcella (Fenech) inherits a taxi business from her father and now sets out on the job of her life. With each new fare she becomes involved with sex and crime all done up 70's Italian comedy style

Title: 129. Dracula's Dog
description: Communist soldiers accidentally unleash Dracula's servant and dog, Zoltan, during Romanian excavations. They set out to find the last living descendant, unaware of danger.

Title: 130. The Farmer
description: Kyle Martin returns from WW2 as a silver star hero, but realizes running a one man farm is not profitable, and the bank wants to foreclose. Then a gambler Johnny has a car accident near his farm, in which Kyle saves his life, and Johnny offers him $1,500, which still isn't enough to save the farm. Then when Johnny past-posts on a horse race for over $50,000, he angers local mobster Passini as he and his three henchmen kill Johnny's bodyguard and then blind Johnny's eyes with acid to "make a example out of him". Johnny asks his girl Betty to ask Kyle to kill Prassini and his men one by one for $50,000, the money he needs to save his farm, which sets the path for revenge.

Title: 131. Unfinished Piece for the Player Piano
description: In Imperial Russia, the nobility has its own entertainments, disputes and worries.

Title: 132. Shakir the Clumsy
description: Kemal Sunal played the role of Shakir who is a dumb and funny guy. He got informed that his uncle passed away and all the possession of his uncle including a supermarket, apartment and etc have been left as heritage.

Title: 133. Outsiders
description: In protest of forced conversion to Islam, the Ceddo (outsiders) kidnap King Demba War's daughter Princess Dior Yacine and hold her hostage.

Title: 134. Black Journal
description: Lea's only son Michele has to endure his mother's zealous affection . She is convinced she rescued him by making a deal with Death. When her son gets engaged to a woman, Lea is ready to make a new deal with Death.

Title: 135. Pardon Mon Affaire, Too!
description: Sequel to Pardon Mon Affaire. Four men continue to explore the fallout from their personal lives. This time they buy a house in the country, but struggle to escape their troubles.

description: During the 20-day leave, war correspondent Lopatin travels by train to the distant city of Tashkent. It's very far from the front but the war seems to be present in people's minds even there.

Title: 137. Love and the Midnight Auto Supply
description: Duke is a mechanic who deals in stolen auto parts. His business is next to a bordello where he maintains several friendships. Several twists lead Duke to take on the establishment and aid the local Hispanic farmworkers.

Title: 138. Erotic Sex Games
description: A nurse who married a wealthy industrialist, feels very attracted to the son of her husband with whom she will maintain a love relationship.

Title: 139. The Kentucky Fried Movie
description: The daily programming of a fictional local TV channel presented as a series of highly irreverent skits.

description: A psychiatrist attempts to uncover a troubled stable boy's disturbing obsession with horses.

description: Jailbait, has a boyfriend Robert who respects her boundaries. After a chaotic party, Lorraine rescues Vicki and hosts her, teaching etiquette. Robert searches for Vicki while she discovers Lorraine's work as an executive liaison.

Title: 144. Rituals
description: Five doctors on a wilderness outing are stalked by disfigured, crazed killers.

description: A bickering couple driving cross-country through California pick up a psychotic hitchhiker who threatens to kill them unless they take him to Mexico.

description: A beautiful, nefarious senior female SS officer/doctor creates a genetic, mutant human hybrid; the beast is a, squat, mongoloid hyper-sexually-driven fiend which she uses to torture and molest female prisoners while get fellow Nazis watch.

Title: 147. Candleshoe
description: Welcome to Candleshoe, a stately English manor where a swashbuckling pirate hid a fortune in Spanish doubloons centuries ago. And that's what young orphan Casey and a sly con man are determined to find.

Title: 148. Rahasia Seorang Ibu
description: A woman imprisoned while pregnant loses everything when her husband suffers a breakdown. Released but rejected by both families, she raises her son alone until he begins searching for the father he's never known.

Title: 149. Love Letters of a Portuguese Nun
description: 16-year-old Maria is forced into Serra D'Aires convent, secretly run by Satanists.

Title: 150. The Last Dinosaur
description: A wealthy big game hunter and his group become trapped in prehistoric times where they are stalked by a ferocious dinosaur.

Title: 151. The Gestapo's Last Orgy
description: A Jewish woman who survived the horrors of a concentration camp revisits the ruins of the camp, along with a former SS officer, and recollects the humiliation, the torture, and the constant abuse she went through.

description: The amorous adventures of Reiko, who lives and works in a rural fishing village. Pinku from 1977.

description: In 1948, two teenagers covertly discover new prohibited games.

description: The delicate story of the impossible love between an older married man and a fourteen-year old schoolgirl.

description: Miguel impersonates director Michael Tracey and puts together a team to shoot a film. With lies, he hires actors who are unaware of the plan. When his partner Bob falls in love with an actress, he tries to avoid Miguel's deadly plan.

description: N° 1 is fearless, irresistible, and licensed to kill. N° 1 is assigned to capture a madman who is killing international financiers. Before getting the bad guy, N° 1 encounters mercenaries from the evil organization K.R.AS.H., killing, rape, arson, slaughter, and mayhem.

Title: 157. Emmanuelle 3
description: Emmanuelle and her architect husband continue their amoral lifestyle in the Seychelles. But when a casual dalliance between her and a film director starts to turn serious her husband shows very traditional signs of jealousy

Title: 158. The Chosen
description: Robert's in charge of constructing a nuclear power plant in the Middle East. Will it be instrumental in prophecies of antichrist's apocalypse?

Title: 159. Fairy in a Cage
description: During World War II, a tyrannical judge exploits his military power to imprison and torture innocents.

Title: 160. Fun with Dick and Jane
description: When a successful, middle-class couple finds themselves unemployed and in debt, they turn to armed robbery in desperation.

Title: 161. Come Play with Me
description: A health-resort where both the clients and the employees easily take their clothes off and have a little fun is the setting of this sex-comedy.

Title: 162. One on One
description: A small-town basketball star goes to college and tries to impress his tutor, teammates, and coach.

Title: 163. Crime Busters
description: An attempted robbery turns to be an unexpected recruitment when two unemployed men mistakenly break into a police office instead of a store.

Title: 164. Madame Claude
description: Madame Claude operated an upscale escort service in Paris, providing high-class call girls to wealthy and powerful men around the world.

Title: 165. Adventures of a Private Eye
description: While a private detective is away on vacation, his not-particularly-bright assistant takes it upon himself to "solve" a case that comes in. Complications ensue.

Title: 166. Sister Emanuelle
description: Having renounced her old life of promiscuity, a nun's sexual and religious identity is challenged by a free-spirited, nymphomaniacal new pupil at her convent and a fugitive killer.

description: Nazi officials recruit prostitutes to gather intelligence on potential plots against Hitler by seducing those suspected of disloyalty within the military ranks.

Title: 168. In a Wild Moment
description: Father takes teen daughter on holiday with friend and his teen daughter. At party, father begins affair with friend's daughter. She wants to reveal relationship, forcing father to choose between truth or deception with friend.

Title: 170. Oedipus orca
description: After her harrowing kidnap ordeal in Snatch (1976), Alice tries to return to her normal life, but her memories still haunt her twisting her psyche even further as no one realizes that she's in need of some serious help.

Title: 171. Day of the Animals
description: A battle for survival is on after a group of hikers battle the insane animals who are living in the mountains of a chemically imbalanced area (due to the depletion of Earth's ozone layer) who are out for revenge against all humans.

Title: 172. Cinderella 2000
description: In the year 2047, sex is forbidden and Big Brother uses robots to keep on eye on everyone. One young girl tries to outwit the government so she can be with the man she loves.

Title: 173. Chatterbox!
description: A young woman who works in a beauty parlor discovers that her vagina can talk, which causes her no end of trouble.

Title: 174. The Van
description: Bobby blows all his college savings on a van and tries to get the girl of his dreams. It's a wild time with Bobby and his friends.

Title: 175. Tentacles
description: A mutated giant octopus wreaks havoc on a California seaside community.

Title: 176. The People That Time Forgot
description: In 1919, a British expedition in the Antarctica region is searching for a lost American explorer and finds a hidden prehistoric world instead.

Title: 177. Presídio de Mulheres Violentadas
description: After being falsely imprisoned for a guard's death, a woman finds herself caught between a ruthless prison director and an inmate leader planning a breakout.

Title: 178. The Day It Came to Earth
description: A glowing meteor falls into a secluded pond into which Mafia hitmen have dumped the body of one of their victims. Students from the local college use the pond for a swimming hole. Then the fun begins.

Title: 179. The Brothers Lionheart
description: Brothers Jonatan and Skorpan lead a revolution against the tyrant Tengil in the magical afterlife land of Nangijala.

Title: 180. Fantasm Comes Again
description: An intern and a professional writer at a newspaper agency read ten letters sent to their sexual advice column detailing the erotic escapades of various women.

Title: 181. Hidden Pleasures
description: A wealthy closeted banker develops an obsessive romantic infatuation with an impoverished teenage student, leading to a destructive relationship with severe consequences for the young man's life.

Title: 182. MacArthur
description: Biopic of General Douglas MacArthur covering his war exploits during WW2 and the Korean War.

Title: 183. The Creature
description: Married woman miscarries after dog attack. Vacation helps her bond with stray dog of same breed. Her relationship with the dog strains marriage, forcing her to choose between husband and canine companion.

Title: 184. Twilight's Last Gleaming
description: An imprisoned rogue USAF general, with a secret personal agenda, escapes the brig and takes over an ICBM silo, threatening to start World War III.

Title: 185. Ruby
description: Sixteen years post Ruby Claire's boyfriend's murder, gruesome killings erupt at her drive-in movie theatre. Her mute daughter Leslie's odd behavior escalates, and a psychic warns of revenge from beyond.

Title: 186. The Choirboys
description: A group of maladjusted, highly unprofessional Los Angeles cops frequently engage in various forms of illegal and unethical activities on and off duty.

Title: 187. Young Lady Chatterley
description: Cynthia Chatterley is a young and beautiful, and a bit naïve. She is about to embark on an incredible odyssey of sexual discovery.

Title: 188. Amar Akbar Anthony
description: Three brothers are separated and united after many years - one is brought up a Hindu, another a Muslim and the last (and most memorable) a Christian. Hilarity and adventure ensues.

Title: 189. Street Warriors
description: A gang of fifteen-year-old living in the suburbs of Barcelona have specialized in car theft. With that cars they are engaged in giving the "pull", storming shops to sell goods and attack couples in secluded places in order to rob them and abuse women. Sometimes caught red-handed, they are persecuted by the police; To escape, they invade the road, circulate in the opposite direction and skip controls, sometimes resulting badly injured.

Title: 190. The Last Remake of Beau Geste
description: An aging Sir Hector Geste takes a young greedy wife who's after his famed Blue Water sapphire, but his sons hide the gem and join the French Foreign Legion in North Africa.

Title: 191. Operation Thunderbolt
description: In 1976, an Air France flight was hijacked to Entebbe, Uganda. Jewish passengers were held hostage to force release of terrorists from Israeli prisons. Israel sent commandos to rescue them. Based on true events from takeoff to return.

Title: 192. The Happy Hooker Goes to Washington
description: The world's most famous madame Xaviera Hollander, now a magazine magnate, is called to Washington to testify before Congress in an indecency trial because she's being held up as a prime example of American moral decay.

Title: 193. Nine Guests for a Crime
description: While spending their annual vacation on a small Mediterranean Island, nine bourgeois family members are stalked and killed one by one by a mysterious killer.

Title: 194. The Domino Principle
description: A Vietnam War veteran who's been imprisoned for murder is offered freedom if he agrees to commit a contract killing for a shady organization.

Title: 195. The Fruit Is Ripe
description: In this sex comedy, a good-looking German girl goes on vacation in Greece, and a large number of people try to get her to go to bed with them. With a light, teasing manner, she turns all of them down, until at last she meets a boy she really likes.

Title: 196. Love Camp
description: A kidnapped woman is trapped inside a jungle brothel ruled by a ruthless warden, while a revolutionary leader's fascination with her reshapes the camp's dangerous power struggle.

Title: 197. End of the World
description: After seeing a man die in a strange accident, Father Pergado visits a retreat where he meets his alien duplicate who plans to conquer Earth.

Title: 198. The Disappearance
description: Contract killer Jay Mallory 's wife Celandine has disappeared from their apartment. When he is hired by members of an international organization to carry out a hit in England, he suspects that they are connected with her disappearance.

Title: 199. Office Romance
description: The life of entire statistical bureau becomes crazy when an ordinary worker, a shy man, falls in love with a boss, a strict woman.

Title: 200. La compagna di banco
description: Lilli Carati plays a high school student being pursued by a very persistent young man in this Italian sex-comedy

Title: 201. Raggedy Ann & Andy: A Musical Adventure
description: Raggedy Ann and Andy leave their playroom to rescue Babette, a beautiful French doll kidnapped by pirates.

Title: 202. Del amor y de la muerte
description: Don Diego, an old feudal lord, goes to the war, leaving his son Gonzalo in his place, imposing only one limitation on his power: two women, mother and daughter, living in a remote mill. The miller Elvira, one of Don Diego's lovers, has a beautiful daughter, Elena, and Gonzalo's desire is focused on both of them. But Elena is also Don Diego's daughter, and to avoid incest, she is married to a young shepherd named Rodrigo.

Title: 203. Charlie and the Hooker
description: Curro is a 16-year-old boy who actively seeks to lose his virginity. He falls madly in love with a prostitute who is 10 years his senior.

Title: 204. The Amsterdam Kill
description: Ex-DEA agent Quinlan enters a labyrinth of deception and death as he tries to destroy a powerful Amsterdam-based drug cartel named 'Juliana'.

Title: 205. Fight for Your Life
description: Three escaped convicts hold a black minister and his family hostage, forcing them to fight for their lives.

Title: 206. First Love
description: A young man is in love for the first time. However, his girlfriend is older than him, from a rich family and has more experience with relationships. Their love is sometimes emotionally draining, but physically very passionate. Can it last?

Title: 207. That Strange Desire to Love
description: Angela and Marco are a new brother and sister, they live in a large country house outside the rest of the world, united by an at least ambiguous relationship, which goes far beyond fraternal affection.

Title: 208. Breaker! Breaker!
description: Follows a truck driver search for his brother, who has disappeared in a town run by a corrupt judge.

Title: 209. The Uncanny
description: Wilbur Gray, a horror writer, has stumbled upon a terrible secret, that cats are supernatural creatures who really call the shots. In a desperate attempt to get others to believe him, Wilbur spews three tales of feline horror.

Title: 210. Blue Sunshine
description: A bizarre series of murders begins in Los Angeles, where people start going bald and then become homicidal maniacs. But could the blame rest on a particularly dangerous form of LSD called Blue Sunshine the murderers took ten years before?

Title: 211. Chor Sipahee
description: Reformist Bombay Police Inspector Shankar Kumar would like to try a new approach to tackle crime - make new leaves of criminals by making them change their ways. He tries this on Raja Khanna alias Raja Dada, but in vain. When he comes to know his family, which consists of unmarried sister, Bharti, and an elderly and ailing mother, he decides that he must do something more to help Raja. Before he could think of anything, Raja is arrested for the murder of a police informer named Bichoo. Shankar destroys the evidence that links Raja to this murder, thus losing his job, facing criminal charges himself, and getting a jail sentence. When he comes out of jail, it is no longer the same Shankar - but one who is ready to join Raja as his criminal partner. But Raja is not the same petty criminal anymore - he has joined forces with international gangs of smugglers and may not quite be receptive to Shankar's request to join his gang. Shankar will now have to prove himself worthy of joining this gang - and for this he may have to sacrifice all virtues that he has learned to live with since his childhood.

Title: 212. Crazy Desires of a Murderer
description: A rich girl invites a few of her friends, including one she befriended during a recent trip to Asia, to her family manor to spend the weekend. Soon, someone gets horribly killed, and secrets and dark desires begin to unravel.

Title: 213. Some Like It Cool
description: While hiding from the royal authorities,Giacomo Casanova, the famous romancer, encounters his look-alike: Giacomino, a fugitive petty con man. Meanwhile, the Arabian Caliph and his wife are arriving in Venice for a state visit, and she insists on a night with the legendary lover. Through a series of erotic encounters and mistaken-identity comedies, Giacomo and Giacomino make their way back to Venice for their appointment with the Caliph's wife.

Title: 214. Prey
description: A deadly shape-shifting alien infiltrates a country house occupied by two lesbians, and proceeds to study their behaviour, for a sinister purpose.

Title: 215. The World's Greatest Lover
description: A neurotic baker travels to Hollywood to attend a talent search for an actor to rival the great Valentino. Although not an actor, through blind luck he succeeds, to a certain degree.

Title: 216. The Joy of Flying
description: Silvia Bergmann runs a fashion boutique in Berlin. Her love life is unsatisfying since her boyfriend prefers to sit in front of the TV.

Title: 217. Captive Women 4
description: To improve the morale of the German officers, a train with beautiful girls is arranged to entertain them when on leave.

Title: 218. In the Realm of Sex
description: Satirizing the Roman Porno genre, and the Office Lady Journal series in particular. Naomi Tani and Yuko Katagiri appear as themselves in the film, making fun of their on-screen personae.

Title: 219. ABBA: The Movie
description: An incompetent radio DJ tries to get an interview with the Swedish pop group during their famous week-long 1977 tour of Australia.

Title: 220. The Chess Players
description: In 1856, two obsessed noblemen ignore everything while playing chess and fail to notice British rule extending into their Indian province.

Title: 221. Greased Lightning
description: The true life story of Wendell Scott, the first black stock car racing driver to win an upper tier NASCAR race.

Title: 222. Watch Me When I Kill
description: Mara, a cabaret performer pulled into a dangerous mystery, finds her routine shattered by a threatening presence. Lukas investigates the strange events surrounding her and uncovers a buried connection.

Title: 223. Billy Jack Goes to Washington
description: After a Senator suddenly dies after completing (and sealing) an investigation into the nuclear power industry, the remaining Senator and the state Governor must decide on a person who will play along with their shady deals and not cause any problems. They decide on Billy Jack, currently sitting in prison after being sent to jail at the end of his previous film, as they don't expect him to be capable of much, and they think he will attract young voters to the party. Billy is pardoned, released, and nominated, after which he begins his duties. He soon notices that things aren't right, and starts trying to find out just what is going on.

Title: 224. Where Time Began
description: Also known as "The Fabulous Journey to the Centre of the Earth" in the UK. The film is partially dubbed in English, but it has good cinematography.

Title: 225. Summerfield
description: A teacher discovers one of his students has a rare blood disease, and is drawn into a mystery that culminates in a thrilling climax.

Title: 226. Beast with a Gun
description: In Italy, escaped sadistic killer Nanni Vitali and his henchmen terrorize the populace and seek revenge against those responsible for Vitali's incarceration.

Title: 227. Can I Do It 'Till I Need Glasses?
description: A comedy comprised of short, sexually-suggestive skits.

Title: 228. Black Deep Throat
description: A newspaper reporter in search of information about an exclusive sex cult.

Title: 229. Tintorera... Tiger Shark
description: Two shark hunters flirt with an attractive British lady while hunting down a large tiger shark terrorizing the Mexican East coast.

Title: 230. A Little Night Music
description: Austria, circa 1900: the actress Desiree Armfeldt becomes entangled with multiple intersecting love affairs, which all converge for an evening at the Viennese country estate of her mother, a former courtesan.

Title: 231. Nazi Love Camp 27
description: As the menacing clouds of WWII spread all over across Europe, a young flaxen-haired Jew woman will witness her idyllic life crumble into pieces as she is rounded up and thrown to forced prostitution at the infamous "joy-camp" 27.

Title: 232. Change of Sex
description: A seventeen year old boy follows the painful path to discovering that he is transsexual.

Title: 233. Silver Bears
description: Financial wizard "Doc" Fletcher acquires a Swiss bank and a silver mine - alleged to be worth a billion dollars. As rivals close in from all sides, Doc must fight a complex struggle to keep hold of both the bank and the mine.

Title: 234. Are You Being Served?
description: The staff of Grace Bros. take a trip to Costa Plonka while the department is being remodeled.

Title: 235. Goodbye & Amen
description: An agent's plot to overthrow an African nation is jeopardized by his friend's interference in the country's politics.

Title: 236. Alice or The Last Escapade
description: Alice leaves husband, car breaks down, spends night at manor. Next day car fixed but owners missing, she's trapped in walled estate, increasingly worried by strange discoveries.

Title: 237. Death Bed: The Bed That Eats
description: A bed possessed by a demon spirit consumes its users alive.

Title: 238. Sweeney!
description: When one of his informants is murdered, Detective Inspector Jack Regan is drawn into a deadly political game. He is soon a marked man and, after being framed, is suspended from duty. This doesn't stop him searching for the truth.

Title: 239. The Squeeze
description: A dangerous, violent gang kidnaps a woman and her daughter to extort some money from her rich husband. He and her down-on-his-luck ex-cop ex-husband decide to deal with the kidnappers themselves.

Title: 240. Beach House
description: Different groups of people share cabin #19 for changing at an Italian beach.

Title: 241. Which Way Is Up?
description: Orange picker Leroy Jones inadvertently becomes a union leader and is forced out of town, leaving behind his wife Annie Mae and his sexually-obsessed father Rufus.

Title: 242. A Dog Called... Vengeance
description: A political prisoner in a South American dictatorship escapes and is pursued throughout the country by a bloodthirsty dog.

Title: 243. Grayeagle
description: In this variant of The Searchers (1956), a tough frontier trapper tracks the young Cheyenne warrior who kidnapped his daughter.

Title: 244. Cathy's Curse
description: A young girl is possessed by the spirit of her aunt, who died in a car accident as a child. Soon, people around her begin to mysteriously die off.

Title: 245. Gulliver's Travels
description: Lemuel Gulliver washes ashore on Lilliput and attempts to prevent war between that tiny kingdom and its equally minuscule rival Blefuscu.

Title: 246. Crossed Swords
description: Poor boy Tom Canty and Edward, Prince of Wales exchange identities, but events force the pair to experience each other's lives as well.

Title: 247. Joyride
description: Three teenagers leave Los Angeles and drive north to Alaska, wind up robbing a pipeline and taking one of the employees hostage.

Title: 248. Taboo
description: Investigates and sheds light on various sexual identities and sexual peculiarities outside the accepted sexual norms.

Title: 249. Hitler's Last Train
description: The SS puts a slutty nightclub singer in charge of a train car full of prostitutes whose "services" are reserved solely for senior Nazis.

Title: 250. Wifemistress
description: A vineyard's manager marries the owner's very young daughter; father dies. Deceit, infidelity. The husband is forced to watch from a distance as his wife blossom socially in his absence; then the plot thickens.

Title: 251. Blood and Diamonds
description: A man is arrested and condemned to five years in jail for robbery. After serving his term, he is out for revenge on the gang members he considers were to blame for his arrest. The prize for this deadly fight is a large cache of diamonds.

Title: 252. Village of Eight Gravestones
description: The heir to a family fortune discovers that a curse has been placed on it, put there centuries before by a band of samurai warriors.

Title: 253. Rape! 13th Hour
description: A serial rapist takes on a young protégé to his craft as he is pursued by a homosexual gang seeking vengeance for an attack on their leader.

Title: 254. Planet of Dinosaurs
description: A space-ship gets lost and is forced to make an emergency landing on an unknown planet. Soon the crew discovers that there are dinosaurs on the planet. The crew have to survive until they hopefully are found and rescued.

Title: 255. You Light Up My Life
description: A young performer struggles to balance her true artistic passions with her father's expectations while navigating complicated relationships and unresolved emotions that hold her back from reaching her full potential.

Title: 256. A Tale of Sorrow and Sadness
description: A female golfer who has exceeded expectations to reach the top not only has to contend with being in-demand, but also with the men in her life, her neigbours, her brother and not to mention a stalker.

Title: 257. The Greatest
description: Muhammad Ali plays himself in a reconstruction of the events that brought him to fame.

Title: 258. 3 Sexy Girls in Tirol
description: Otto runs a hotel for tourists in Tyrolia but has troubles both with the economy and with his wife Olga. After a trip to Stockholm he imports three Swedish blondes who eventually save Otto from disaster, both marital and financial.

Title: 259. The Child
description: A newly hired housekeeper arrives to her employer's house in the countryside. She slowly discovers that the only child in the house, an 11-year-old girl, hides a deadly secret.

Title: 260. The Devil's Three Golden Hairs
description: The king is out to kill Jacob; in a letter, he effectively hands him his own death sentence. Fortunately, Jacob falls into the hands of some friendly robbers, who alter the contents of the letter.

Title: 262. The Lacemaker
description: A reserved young woman moves into an apartment with a young student she met while on vacation.

Title: 263. Secret Honeymoon: Rape Train
description: Two petty criminals escape their pursuers to the church where they take the newly-arrested bride and jump a moving train whose empty freight car provides a hiding place for them.

Title: 264. Beauty and the Beast
description: Decameron-style collection of entertaining short stories with such diverse themes as nymphomania, bestiality, and masochism.

Title: 265. Ham and Chips
description: Tension builds between the competing hotel and fry stand owners in a small Belgian town, dividing locals until their kids unexpectedly fall for each other.

Title: 266. Bad
description: Hazel runs a beauty salon out of her house, but makes extra money by providing ruthless women to do hit jobs. L.T. is a parasite, and contacts Hazel looking for work when he runs out of money. She is reluctant to use him for a hit, since she prefers using women, but decides to try him on a trial basis. Meanwhile, the local cop she pays off wants an arrest to make it look like he's actually doing his job, but she doesn't want to sacrifice any of her "associates." Several other side plots are woven in, populated with characters from the sleazy side of life.

Title: 267. Animal
description: The funny misadventures of a dating duo of movie stunt professionals in France.

Title: 268. Blue Passion
description: Six American special agents are sent to an idyllic Greek island to disrupt the operation of an international operation of illegal arms deals and African based terrorists. Three agents are killed - so their team has an infiltrated enemy.

Title: 269. The Black Panther
description: A gung-ho ex-military man pursues a secret life of crime, culminating in the kidnapping of a teenage heiress.

Title: 270. War of the Planets
description: Captain Alex Hamilton investigates a strange signal on Earth and a UFO above Antarctica, discovering a giant robot enslaving humanoids and observing Earth from an unknown planet.

Title: 271. Vanessa
description: Olivia Pascal stars as Vanessa. Having been raised in a convent after her parents' deaths, she travels to Hong Kong to claim an inheritance, only to discover that the inheritance is a chain of bordellos. She soon has trouble coping with her inheritance as she is thrust into her new world of carnal delights.

Title: 272. Fiona
description: Heavily fictionalised 'autobiography' of 70s sex superstar Fiona Richmond.

Title: 273. Viva Knievel!
description: He's powered his Harley over cars, trucks, lions, infernos and plummeted headlong into a canyon. But if the mob has its way, his next incredible leap will land him six feet under.

Title: 274. Naughty Freshmen
description: In the studio of a radio house, a housewife, a juvenile psychologist, a head study director and a detective inspector talk about the Youth Protection Act.

Title: 275. Death Promise
description: An apartment dweller goes on a search-and-destroy mission to kill the ruthless landlords who murdered his father.

Title: 276. The Pack
description: The residents of a vacation spot named Seal Island find themselves terrorized by a pack of feral dogs made up of former pets that were abandoned by tourists who visited the island for the summer and left them there after they went home.

Title: 277. Summer City
description: The exploits of four boys who leave Sydney and head out for a weekend of surfing and adventure. Unfortunately the fun takes a serious turn when they find themselves involved in a murder.

Title: 278. Moonshine County Express
description: When a hillbilly moonshiner is murdered by a powerful competitor, his tough three daughters discover a stash of prohibition whiskey and start undercutting their father's killer's business, with help from a local race car driver.

Title: 279. Speedtrap
description: A PI tackles a string of mysterious car thefts, aided by his cop ex-girlfriend. Facing resistance from the police chief, he navigates a complex web of clues, psychics, and mobsters to crack the case and unmask the elusive thief.

Title: 280. Executioners from Shaolin
description: After the destruction of the Temple, a Shaolin disciple devotes years to mastering Tiger style in order to defeat the martial arts master who killed his teacher. His wife, a Crane style specialist, has a feeling one style won't be enough.

Title: 281. The Black Widow
description: Matea is an orphan who assists the priest, Father Feliciano, in his parish. The village doctor tries to seduce her, but fails and proceeds to defame her into believing that Matea maintains relations with the priest.

Title: 282. Joyride to Nowhere
description: Teen friends Cindy and Leah run away from abusive homes and steal a car to start a new life. After unknowingly taking a thief's car with $2 million inside, they become the target of a dangerous criminal determined to get his money back.

Title: 283. Blue Rita
description: Nightclub owner and erotic dancer Rita Blue uses her place as a front for working undercover as a spy. Motivated by her vehement hatred of men that stems from having been sexually abused as a child, Rita and her seductive female cohorts not only gleefully torture guys as a means to obtain vital information, but also manhandle wealthy men in order to make them hand over their fortunes to them.

Title: 284. Inquisition
description: A witch-finder general falls in love with the village beauty, who has supposedly made a pact with the devil.

Title: 285. Weapons of Death
description: A police commissioner tries to bring a gangster to justice as the kingpin's out-of-control crimes set even his own underworld allies against him.

Title: 286. Why Not!
description: The eventful life of a three-way household in a suburban pavilion arouses the curiosity of those around them, including that of a police inspector.

Title: 287. I Am the Law
description: In 1925, Cesare Mori - known as the "Iron Prefect" for his iron-fisted methods - wages a one-man war against the Mafia in Fascist Sicily.

Title: 288. Feng hua xue yue
description: Like Li's later Return of the Dead (1979), Moods of Love interweaves themes of vengeance and karmic retribution in two sultry tales of fatal seduction.

Title: 289. Nurse Sherri
description: A hospital nurse is possessed by an evil spirit, and proceeds to kill off the hospital's patients.

Title: 290. Thunder and Lightning
description: A young man who hauls liquor for moonshiners comes up against a competing gang of moonshiners who intend to get rid of him and take over his operation.

Title: 291. Daana Veera Soora Karna
description: Karna faces a lot of hardships owing to his low birth. When Duryodhana befriends him, he goes to great lengths to honour their friendship and aids him in the battle against the Pandavas.

Title: 292. The Cynic, the Rat and the Fist
description: A hardened cop is left for dead by the henchmen of a escapee gangster he had previously arrested, and upon recovery relentlessly pursues them.

Title: 293. Eros Eterna
description: "Eros Eterna" tells the story of a legendary immortal nun who wanders around encountering several people of various conditions.

Title: 294. The Two of Them
description: A young woman, married to a volatile alcoholic, has a competing claim on her affections from an older woman who tries to protect her and her daughter.

Title: 295. Scalpel
description: When an unhinged surgeon happens across a young woman with her face beaten beyond recognition, he sees an opportunity to put his trusty scalpel to use - hatching a plan to "reconstruct" her face in the image of his missing daughter.

Title: 296. Cara dolce nipote
description: Daniela travels to stay with her widowed uncle, who wrestles with temptation as his pretty house-guest flaunts her sexuality by showering with the door open and casually walking around nude.

Title: 297. Beauties by Night
description: A boxer in the twilight of his career is forced to work at a famous night club called "King Kong" in order to support his beloved sister.

Title: 298. Man, Woman and Beast
description: Inspired by Bataille and Sade, an original episodic erotic comedy.

Title: 299. Madame Rosa
description: Madame Rosa, an ex-prostitute of Jewish origin, lives in a dilapidated old building in Belleville. Tired and worn out by life, she looks after young children, placed in her care by the social welfare people.

Title: 300. Final Chapter: Walking Tall
description: Buford Pusser's last days as Sheriff of McNairy County, Tennessee in 1970 and his subsequent death in 1974.

Title: 301. September 30, 1955
description: When Jimmy's idol, James Dean, dies on September 30, 1955, the small-town Arkansas college undergraduate goes berserk. He and five of his friends hold a vigil which turns into a drunken debauch--and, finally, a tragedy.

Title: 302. Messalina, Messalina
description: The story of Messalina's rise to power amid her relationship with Emperor Claudius.

Title: 303. The Virgo, the Taurus and the Capricorn
description: Distressed that her wayward husband, Gianni, forsakes her favors and seduces a series of other women, drop-dead gorgeous Gioia turns to handsome lothario Patrizio to help her get revenge.

Title: 304. Petey Wheatstraw
description: After being murdered by his rivals, Petey Wheatstraw is resurrected, in exchange for marrying the devil's daughter, the world's ugliest woman.

Title: 305. The Private Files of J. Edgar Hoover
description: The story of the late J. Edgar Hoover, who was head of the FBI from 1924-1972. The film follows Hoover from his racket-busting days through his reign under eight U.S. presidents.

Title: 306. What's Up Nurse!
description: A newly arrived doctor at a hospital discovers the nurses' unorthodox methods of caring for patients, which involve sexual activities. He soon embraces their practices and indulges in the after-hours debauchery.

Title: 307. Scott Joplin
description: Details the life story of Scott Joplin and how he became the greatest ragtime composer of all time.

Title: 308. Angela
description: A war vet finds out that a former prostitute had his baby. Doubting it's his, he gives it away, so she reports him. Twenty years later, she still wants to find her son. She meets a young man and falls in love, but the vet's prison term ends.

Title: 309. Cherry Hill High
description: Five sexy high school graduates try to lose their virginity in a creative manner.

Title: 310. The Crater Lake Monster
description: A meteor that crashed into Oregon's Crater Lake unearths a dinosaur egg. The heat from the meteor causes the egg to hatch, and the emerging dinosaur takes to snacking on the locals.

Title: 311. Climax
description: Ana is a young girl with the same problems as any girl her age.

Title: 312. Prime Time
description: Some unknown source has interrupted all television transmissions around the world. In place of the regular broadcasts, a lineup of extremely tasteless programs and commercials have been substituted. Included in the mix are such show as The Shitheads, The Charles Whitman Invitational, and commercials for a number of improbable products.

Title: 313. Hitler: A Film from Germany
description: Hitler's rise and Nazism are depicted in a theatrical, experimental style, using actors, puppets, and projections to explore his historical role and enduring myth in German culture.

Title: 314. The Dancing Hawk
description: Michal Toporny is a poor country boy whose determination and hard work help him climb the social ladder and become the head of a large factory in the city. But at what cost?

Title: 315. Dangerous Cargo
description: A mutiny aboard a weapon smuggling vessel results in the ship's first officer dead, the captain incapacitated, and the captain's wife vulnerable.

Title: 316. Hum Kisise Kum Naheen
description: Kajal, an affluent girl, comes across her estranged childhood lover Manjeet and decides to marry him. Everything is hunky-dory until she discovers that Manjeet has devised a plan to kidnap her.

Title: 317. Beyond Good and Evil
description: Nietzsche, his friend, and a Jewish woman form a complex relationship while exploring philosophy beyond morality. The story follows the philosopher's descent into opium addiction and madness.

Title: 318. Yeti: Giant of the 20th Century
description: Professor Wassermann is asked by industry magnate Morgan Hunnicut to lead an expedition to study the giant Yeti creature found frozen in a large ice block.

Title: 319. Checkered Flag or Crash
description: Race car driver Walkaway Madden signs up for the big Manila 1000 off-road race through the jungle in the Philippines. Photojournalist C.C. Wainwright comes along for the ride.

Title: 320. Double Exposure
description: James Compton is paid by wealthy Howard Townsend to photograph his mistress Simone . Intimate photo sessions lead to an affair. Simone is kidnapped and he is being blackmailed over the affair by the kidnappers. Some violent scenes.

Title: 321. I Am Afraid
description: Journey into the fears of the escort agent Graziano, guilty of knowing too much.

Title: 322. Viva Italia!
description: Several episodes depicting Italian's life in short humoristic stories.

Title: 323. Mr. Billion
description: When an American billionaire dies, his poor Italian nephew inherits everything, provided he can arrive in the USA to claim his inheritance before the deadline but the corporate lawyer-executor tries to steal the inheritance.

Title: 324. Too Hot to Handle
description: Sexy adventure film has international hit lady Caffaro involved in James Bondish escapades in Manila.

Title: 325. Stop Calling Me Baby!
description: A man hires a P.I. to find a hot woman he fell in love with. The woman lives with her underage teen sister who dreams about having sex for the first time, but wants a real man. That's when the P.I. shows up and stirs up the household.

Title: 326. Yellow Emanuelle
description: A British pilot is attacked after a night out and wakes in a hospital where he falls for his doctor, Emy Wong. She tells him she's bound by ancient East Asian tradition to marry a stranger she's never met.

Title: 327. The Getting of Wisdom
description: An unruly teen from rural Australia struggles to adapt when sent to a rigid Victorian boarding school in the city.

Title: 328. The Great Smokey Roadblock
description: After his rig is repossessed, an aging trucker by the name of Elegant John Howard decides he and his truck have one more good run in them, and with the help of a hitchhiker and a few others he will make it happen.

Title: 329. Fist of Fury II
description: After Chen Zhen's execution in Shanghai, the Japanese feared that his death would unite all Chinese kung fu schools against them. Fearing this, the Japanese gave orders to the head of the Hong Ku School, Miyamoto (Lo Lieh) to surpass all Chinese schools including the Ching Wu School. Miyamoto sends the Japanese along with their interpreter to the Ching Wu School ordering the leader & students to leave the School. When they refuse, the Japanese beat up the students and destroys the school. Meanwhile, one Chinese learns about the destruction of the Ching Wu School when he goes to Shanghai to visit Chen Zhen's grave. This Chinese is the only one who has the guts to fight the Japanese, this Chinese is known as Chen Shen (Bruce Li) who is the brother of Chen Zhen and he vows to avenge his brother's death and end the terror of the Japanese once and for all.

Title: 330. Golden Rendezvous
description: On a cargo ship converted into a cruise-liner, First Officer John Carter foils the plan of international hijackers to use his vessel as bait for a passing U.S. Treasury ship carrying gold bullion.

Title: 331. Welcome to Blood City
description: A group of people find themselves as slaves in what looks like a Wild West town, but with no memory of who they are or how they got there. In this town, people advance through killing others. One of the people decides to go for the top position.

Title: 332. Tell Her That I Love Her
description: A man is desperately attaining beloved woman, despite her husband and child.

Title: 333. The Stick Up
description: In 1930s England, a shady American and an Irish lass try to improve their fortunes using less-than-honest methods.

Title: 334. SS Lager 5: L'inferno delle donne
description: As WWII nears its end, female inmates endure unimaginable atrocities at a Nazi camp. Trapped in a nightmare of abuse and experimentation, they struggle to stay alive. With Soviet troops closing in, their strength is pushed to the limit.

Title: 335. Stunts
description: After a stunt man dies while he is involved in the making of a motion picture, his brother takes his place in order to find out what really happened.

Title: 336. Porno Nights of the World
description: Laura Gemser introduces herself, "It's your old friend Emanuelle again..." to present a sexy mondo film, with her voice-off narration over the different sketches, and reproaching comments between them. Main scenes: a stripper disrobes her safari outfit and performs with a man in a gorilla costume; another stripper performs with a couple of dogs; in Amsterdam, a prostitute disrobes on a street window, then invites one man in for a free session; in Paris, there's a place showing nude roller-skating, and nude mud wrestling; in Denmark, Mandrake the magician transforms his sexy female assistant into a hermaphrodite; an adulterous African couple is punished by genital mutilation and decapitation; in Amsterdam, there is a brothel where so called taxi-mothers prostitute their daughters; in a sex club, women behind a screen have anal sex with unseen men who could be their husbands; in New Guinea, natives rip the head off of a virgin chicken in a bloody ritual; in Hong Kong, an all-girl nightclub with female strippers; Great Omar puts on a show for hundreds of screaming female fans, who boo him after he tires after bedding about 24 women on stage; and a woman inserts ping-pong balls up her vagina, and plops them out.

Title: 337. Achtung! The Desert Tigers
description: Durng World War II, an American major is captured by the Germans and thrown into a POW camp run by a sadistic Nazi officer, whose main pleasures are whipping the local female population and torturing prisoners. The major organizes an escape attempt using the camp's nubile female doctor as a hostage.

Title: 338. Game Show Models
description: A soft-porn drama about the ins and outs within the office of a sleazy, middle sized, Hollywood PR firm.

Title: 339. The Heroin Busters
description: An Italian policeman goes undercover to break up an international heroin smuggling ring, and butts heads with a hot-tempered Interpol agent assigned to the same task.

Title: 340. Beauty's Exotic Dance: Torture!
description: Based on real-life Japanese S&M artist Seiu Ito. This tells the story of Ito meeting a prostitute who becomes his newest model for bondage artwork. Through flashbacks we see how he had used his ex-wife as a model for bondage and torture.

Title: 341. The Love Letters from Teralba Road
description: A violent man (Bryan Brown), who ostensibly has a slight mental illness due to fillings in his teeth, continues to write letters to his estranged girlfriend, Kris McQuade. She sees that he expresses himself more dearly in his letters and he is still quick tempered when they try to rekindle their relationship.

Title: 342. The Invincible Armour
description: A corrupt official frames a man for murder. The man studies a martial arts style that makes his body as strong as iron, so he can counter the official's own incredible fighting skills.

Title: 343. Fire Sale
description: Ben and Ruth Fikus are driving to Florida, but Benny needs someone to look after his store and reluctantly chooses his son Russel. While Russel doesn't get much respect from his parents, he's better off than his disowned brother Ezra.

Title: 344. Eyes Behind the Wall
description: Ivano is a wheelchair-bound man with some strange perversions. He gets his sexual kicks by spying on Arturo, their tenant in the apartment next-door and forcing his sexy accomplice Olga to watch as well. To increase his perverse thrill, on the pretext of "research," Ivano persuades Olga to seduce Arturo and to have sex him as he watches. Unfortunately for all involved, the sex game starts to get very deadly.

Title: 345. Terror of Frankenstein
description: Victor Frankenstein's search for the secret of life leads to the creation of a monster that consumes his life and family.

Title: 346. The Nurse on a Military Tour
description: Army Doctor Eva Marini wants to join a regiment to secure equal rights for women. So her commanding officer sends her off to a boot camp led by Renzo Montagnani, where only the most unruly soldiers end up.

Title: 347. The Red Nights of the Gestapo
description: An illustrious group of German industrialists plot to overthrow Hitler by negotiating a peace treaty with England. Disgraced but dedicated Nazi officer Colonel Werner von Uhland is assigned by his superiors to ferret out these deceitful dissidents and stop them before it's too late. He recruits a bunch of beautiful women to seduce these traitors and undermine their conspiracy.

Title: 348. The Brute
description: A battered fashion model attempts to escape from the clutches of her sadistic husband.

Title: 349. Murder Story
description: Story of a Murder targets sexism, as well as the emerging Icelandic middle class, its consumerist proclivities and this families, perversity. Daughter Anna is in her early twenties, and at loose ends. She works an office job that bores her, and is in a romance with a pompous pseudo-intellectual. Anna's father, Robert, is a brutal tyrant who terrorizes his poor, put-upon wife Margret. On the surface, Robert is appalling enough, but underneath he's far, far worse. Just how far he'll go and how Anna and Margret will respond gets more shocking as the film progresses.

Title: 350. The Yellow Handkerchief
description: Three complete strangers embark on a road-trip to Hokkaido.

Title: 351. The Guy from Harlem
description: A private detective operating in Miami is hired to protect the wife of an African head of state in town for diplomatic business, and to recover the daughter of the leader of a criminal organization, who has been kidnapped by a rival gang.

Title: 352. Il mostro
description: A low rank journalist at Tribuna Sera newspaper receives a letter one day. His correspondence contains a serial killer's letters, which he exploits.

Title: 353. The Boxer
description: A young boxer accidentally kills an ex-boxing champion's brother. He then approaches the ex-champ to train him to become the next champion.

Title: 354. Uncle Tom's Cabin
description: Broken and beaten to the point of no return, a sadistic plantation owner pushes his slaves to the point of rebellion.

Title: 355. The Mouse and His Child
description: Adaptation of Russell Hoban's novel about two mechanical toy mice, and their quest to become "self-winding".

Title: 356. The Ransom
description: A Native American travels around a resort town, murdering cops and rich people with a high-powered crossbow, while demanding that the town's richest residents pay him money to stop the killings.

Title: 357. Roseland
description: "Roseland" is made up of three stories, sometimes connecting, all set in the famed New York dance palace, and all having the same theme: finding the right dance partner.

Title: 358. Whiskey Mountain
description: Bill, Dan, Diana, and Jamie, four motorcyclists who arrived at Whiskey Mountain for a treasure hunt, are terrorized in the woods by a gang of murderous hillbilly drug dealers.

Title: 359. Tomorrow I'll Wake Up and Scald Myself with Tea
description: Jan is a decent, boring man, living a decent, boring life as a rocket designer. When his adventurous twin brother dies in a breakfast accident, Jan decides to impersonate him, unwittingly becoming a part of a Nazi time travel conspiracy.

Title: 360. Nasty Habits
description: In a Philadelphia convent, two nuns battle it out to be elected to the position of head abbess, and neither is about to let anything stand in the way of getting what she wants.

Title: 361. L'homme pressé
description: Pierre is an antique dealer living in our modern fast paced society. The rub is he tries to move even faster than the surrounding world. Alain Delon and Mireille Darc (Pierre's wife) starr

Title: 362. Dagny
description: Dagny Juell was the doctors daughter who left Kongsvinger for Berlin to study music, and became famous painter Edvard Munchs mistress.

Title: 363. Dharam Veer
description: Movie revolves around two brothers who are separated during birth but meet as adults and form a deep friendship. Also about the challenges that test their friendship.

Title: 364. California
description: After the Civil War, Michael "California" Random, is released from prison and goes to Missouri with his partner William. He is killed by bandits. California decides to return the belongings to his family and help them against outlaws.

Title: 365. It's Murder!
