He is told that it is virtually impossible in this time and age to come up with this amount, unless one is involved in smuggling, drugs, and robberies. Kishan decides to re-locate to Bombay, and try and earn the money. He meets with Gafoore Mistry, and together they set out to accumulate the money, trying all sorts of chores, including stunt driving for movies. Kishan then rescues a young woman named Radha from hoodlums, and learns from her that her cop brother, Laxman, is imprisoned for a murder he did not commit, and is to be hanged soon. Kishan decides to help her brother, and in order to do this, he gets himself arrested and imprisoned in the same jail as Laxman. This is where he will learn that life is not all that easy, and there are easier ways to make the 25,000 rupess he needs for the marriage of his sister.

Title: 954. Canal Zone
description: On the one hand, you have the Panamians, but Frederick Wiseman shows them as the Americans see them: from a distance. They are poor and of no particular interest to them even if Panama is THEIR country. But the Canal Zone belongs to the USA and what really matters is THEMSELVES living in closed circuit, worshiping the standards of American culture, God and Coca Cola, money and nationalism...

Title: 955. Aftenlandet
description: Dystopian presentation of a Denmark in imminent risk of sinking into police violence and a military coup.

Title: 956. Violanta
description: A young man raises the dead in a high valley where the power is held by Violanta.

Title: 957. Bonjour Amour
description: Adolescent French suburban lower-middle-class nerd Marc Morel was happy being the teacher's pet and school representative in a Latin competition. Until he meets and instantly falls in love with fatherless semi-illiterate shop clerk and ditto-daughter Martine Pérez. As his overbearing father Robert feared, stripling hormones run wild at the expense of academic future-building, but paternal authority is overruled by 'young love', which even yields peer-acceptance. Cool big brother Christian, a photographer, tries a more understanding approach, but even that runs into trouble.

Title: 958. Polk County Pot Plane
description: A criminal gang bust two of their incarcerated colleagues out of jail in order for them to take on a high profile drug smuggling operation.

Title: 959. Nerone
description: Parody of real life events of the Roman emperor Nero.

Title: 961. Al Shayatteen
description: The story revolves around a national political association in the 1940s, joined by a group of national youth, who see violence as one of the most important means of overthrowing the regime.

Title: 963. D'improvviso al terzo piano
description: Smugglers choose a quiet seaside hotel for illegal transfer of money. They came up with a hiding bundles of banknotes in coffins and stealing a real corpses from the morgue to protect themselves from suspicion.

Title: 964. Gyaniji
description: Same movie as Sat Sri Akal (1977). The entire movie was also shot simultaneously in Hindi.

Title: 965. Cracking Up
description: California is devastated by a big earthquake and, in a series of hilarious vignettes, a television station conducts interviews with the citizenry.

Title: 966. Bhuvana Oru Kelvikkuri
description: What is important in life? Getting money by losing moral values, relations etc or leading a life with conviction and thus winning hearts and trust of near and dear.

Title: 967. Ladrões de Cinema
description: After assaulting a Hollywood film crew, a group of residents of a community in Rio de Janeiro decided to produce a film that would express the reality of Brazil - with the theme of Inconfidência Mineira.

Title: 968. Da jiao niang zi
description: A housewife is searching for her errant husband as he seeks revenge on his killers.

Title: 970. Po sekretu vsemu svetu
description: Po secretu vsemu svetu, "In secret to the whole world", is a 1976 Soviet two-part television film produced by Belarusfilm. It is adapted from Victor Dragunskys popular childrens book The Adventures of Dennis, a collection of short stories told from the perspective of a young boy.

Title: 972. Kiri-no-hata
description: Masao is falsely accused and jailed for the murder of a loanshark to whom he owed a lot of money. His sister Kiriko makes the long trip to Tokyo, specifically to accost Otsuka, Japan's top criminal defence lawyer, and plead with him to take her brother's case. They live in KitaKyushu which, though a city, she contends that the local lawyers are not up to the job. Otsuka contemptuously brushes her off. A year passes. Masao has suicided in jail, his appeal having failed due to the lack of interest and competence of the local defence lawyer. Kiriko returns to Tokyo, planning revenge on Otsuka for refusing the case and causing her brother's death. Meanwhile, through the actions of a crusading young journalist, Otsuka is informed of Masao's death. His curiosity piqued, he requests the file and reviews the evidence. Otsuka also has an adoring mistress who owns a bar. By coincidence (?), the real murderer is an associate of one of her employees. Kiriko, now working as a hostess in a different bar, is asked by a friend to tail her boyfriend, whom she suspects of cheating. The boyfriend is murdered in the bar owner's flat, and Kiriko grabs the chance to set her revenge plan into action. Kiriko rigs the crime scene to falsely incriminate the bar owner, who is subsequently jailed. Otsuka's mistress out of the way, Kiriko sets out to seduce and entrap Otsuka, against the advice of the crusading journalist.

Title: 973. Jallian Wala Bagh
description: The whole film is a story about Jallianwala Bagh massacre in Amritsar.

Title: 974. Xiang Gang qi an 5: Jian mo
description: The Teenager's Nightmare: The police have their hands full with a slippery rapist preying on helpless teenage girls. Gun: Three teenagers' lives change forever when they find a package containing a gun, hand grenades and ammunition.

Title: 975. Le diable dans la boîte
description: Brissot, an uneventful executive, sees his daily life turned upside down when he learns that he is part of a "cart". Considering himself the victim of injustice, he began a hunger strike at his workplace in order to force management to reinstate him. Quickly, supporters and opponents of the striker clash within the company, while the CEO and his deputy maneuver to expel him as quickly as possible. But the framework is changing, now the devil is in the box.

Title: 977. Fraude matrimonial
description: Julio's mother forces him to marry a female student to free him from his love for a painter.

Title: 978. Gate of Flesh
description: A tale of prostitutes in American-occupied Japan, following the end of World War 2.

Title: 979. Arxadan Vurulan Zärbä
description: When former security officer Ahmad Gamarli is mysteriously murdered, investigator Gunduz Karimbeyli is assigned to solve the case. His investigation uncovers hidden motives and dangerous figures connected to the crime.

Title: 980. Heinrich
description: The life and struggles of the German writer Heinrich von Kleist.

Title: 983. Dream Girl
description: Sapna, a thief who steals for orphans' welfare, meets Anupam Verma posing as a princess. He welcomes her into his home. Her past as Champabai, a prostitute, is revealed, jeopardizing her charade and relationship with Anupam.

Title: 984. Aslan Bacanak
description: A new jitney driver comes to neighborhood and competes with another jitney driver (also a respected bully) for his sister's hand in marriage.

Title: 985. Roots Rock Reggae
description: Roots Rock Reggae depicts an unforgettable moment in Jamaica's history when music defined the island's struggles and immortalised its heroes.

Title: 986. Noch nad Chili
description: A Soviet docudrama chronicling the events surrounding the military coup which toppled the leftist Chilean government of Salvador Allende in September 1973.

Title: 987. Looking Up
description: Family secrets are revealed as three generations of a middle-class New York Jewish family come together in this story of good relations and bad relations.

Title: 989. Abelard
description: Two women jilted by their veterinary-assistant lover take excruciating revenge.

Title: 990. Rusalka
description: A water sprite in Slavonic legend. The Rusalka is thus the title of operas by (1) Dargomizhsky, produced in St Petersburg, 1856; libretto by composer, after Pushkin; (2) Dvorak, produced in Prague, 1901; libretto by J kvapil. [from The New Penguin Dictionary of Music, Arthur Jacobs]

Title: 991. Plus ça va, moins ça va
992. Le regard
description: A couple in a hotel room in Brussels. A painting by Brueghel. In this painting, a mystery.

Title: 993. The Shaolin Brothers
description: Complicated mix of Chinese history and myth, where old Shaolin friends find themselves on different sides, one a Ching general, and the other faithful to Ming. Deception is used as well as kung fu skills to move the plot on. Humourous parts actually confuse the whole story, but is full of entertaining martial art action.

Title: 994. Kanneshwara Rama
description: "Kanneshwara Rama " is a 1977 Indian Kannada film, directed by "M S Sathyu" and Produced by " Moola Brothers".The film Stars "Ananthnag, Shabana Azmi, Amol Palekar, B V Karanth, Malathi, Dheerendra Gopal, Ashok Mandanna", in lead roles. The film had musical score by "B V Karanth". Watch the full Movie, Kanneshwara Rama , online, only On Eros Now.

Title: 995. Home to the Night
description: Story of a young Finnish worker who comes to Sweden, gets married, has a child, gets into a fight that costs another man his life, and returns to Finland.

Title: 996. Paradh
description: A wealthy man purchases an old mansion but is perplexed to find a mysterious locked room.

Title: 997. Along Comes a Tiger
description: A mysterious martial arts master takes revenge on the black Dragon gang for the murder of his father.

Title: 998. Blue Fire Lady
description: A girl's love of horses meets with her father's disapproval.

Title: 999. Omeng Satanasia
description: Due to numerous failures, an aging scientist who is trying to create a formula to bring back his youth decided to sell his soul to a gay demon and must find true love within a year.

Title: 1000. Crecer de golpe
description: It tells the complex relationship of Milo, a teenager, and his old protector. Adaptation of "Around the cage", work of the writer Haroldo Conti, disappeared in 1976 by Argentine dictatorship.
